csharpCode: using UnityEngine; using Unity.Netcode.Components; using UnityEditor; public class CheckClientNetAnim { public static string Run() { string log = ""; GameObject prefab = AssetDatabase.LoadAssetAtPath<GameObject>("Assets/Prefabs/Player.prefab"); if (prefab == null) return "No player prefab"; NetworkAnimator netAnim = prefab.GetComponentInChildren<NetworkAnimator>(); if (netAnim != null) { log += "Component Type: " + netAnim.GetType().Name; if (netAnim.GetType().Name != "ClientNetworkAnimator") { log += "\nReplacing with ClientNetworkAnimator..."; GameObject go = netAnim.gameObject; Animator anim = netAnim.Animator; Object.DestroyImmediate(netAnim, true); var clientAnim = go.AddComponent<ClientNetworkAnimator>(); clientAnim.Animator = anim; EditorUtility.SetDirty(prefab); PrefabUtility.SavePrefabAsset(prefab); log += "\nReplaced."; } } return log; } }
